findings.expected: The delivery handoff and delivery summary identify the r8 design manifest and its matching phase and cross-stage approval records.
findings.observed: The delivery package-shape check passes structurally but reports its handoff and delivery summary at revision r7; the handoff cites the r7 manifest and verdicts.
findings.remediation: Admiral updates the delivery handoff and summary to the approved r8 package and carries the r8 open qualification limit for live V4L2 DMA-BUF behavior.
findings.statement: The approved r8 design package is ready for DESIGN -> BUILD, but the active delivery handoff still submits revision r7 and names the r7 manifest and approvals. The next consumer would therefore receive a different design contract than the one approved in this submission.
findings.verification: Re-run the delivery package-shape check and the design-to-build boundary validator against r8, confirming one revision, matching approval lineage, and no blocked phrases.
